Cost of electricity: An overall increase in electricity is observed, probably partially due to the use of the technology.

Revenues: Although it is difficult to attribute the increase in productivity solely to the DATS, it is still possible that it influences animal welfare, feed conversion rate, and the profitability of the business

Net Benefit: From the available data, by comparing the two scenarios with and without DATSs, it is possible to notice how the DATS leads to a positive outcome in terms of cost- benefit analysis, primarily due to the increase in productivity
